verdict_reason: EuroCrops (LPIS), FTW boundaries, and AlphaEarth embeddings are all openly licensed, direct-download or GEE-accessible; none needs an application. EU scope capped at ~16-17 LPIS-open states; error-type ground truth must be hand-constructed.

sources.name: EuroCrops (harmonized LPIS parcel declarations)
sources.licence_quote: This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License
sources.coverage_quote: 17 EU countries: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Germany, Denmark, Estonia, Spain, France, Croatia, Lithuania, Latvia, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Sweden, Slovenia, Slovakia
sources.date_range: Varies by country, mostly 2018-2021 (e.g. Austria 2021, France 2018, Denmark 2019)
caveats_quoted: From all red coloured countries...it was not possible to obtain publicly available data: GDPR issues, missing incentive to publish, no response from responsible authorities

sources.name: Fields of The World (FTW) benchmark dataset
sources.licence_quote: CC-BY-4.0 (Austria, Spain,...); CC0-1.0 (Denmark, Luxembourg, Netherlands); CC-BY-NC-4.0 (Latvia, Portugal)
sources.coverage_quote: 70,462 samples, ~1.6M parcel boundaries; 45 countries incl. 17 EU states: Austria, Belgium, Croatia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany + 9 more
caveats_quoted: Per-country licence varies: Latvia and Portugal are CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial), not plain CC-BY

sources.name: Fields of The World (FTW) Global boundary + confidence product
sources.coverage_quote: First global, wall-to-wall agricultural field-boundary dataset at 10 m resolution, 195 countries and territories, ~3.2 billion polygons (2024+2025)
caveats_quoted: This is the conservative-by-design behavior of the confidence layer: it does not certify predictions in regions whose visual signature differs from those seen during training
real fields in underrepresented smallholder systems may be filtered out; examine unfiltered product and continuous confidence raster rather than the default threshold

sources.name: AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding V1 Annual
sources.licence_quote: This dataset is licensed under CC-BY 4.0
sources.date_range: 2017-01-01 to 2025-01-01, one image per calendar year
caveats_quoted: The dataset provides one year of data per image, with time properties reflecting calendar years - confirmed ANNUAL, not sub-annual

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Hand-classify a stratified sample of LPIS-FTW mismatched parcels into merge/split/encroachment/offset via visual overlay on Sentinel-2/orthophoto, using IoU and centroid-offset geometry rules to pre-screen candidates.
ground_truth.label_count_estimate: Low hundreds of hand-verified parcels across 2-3 pilot LPIS-open countries (e.g. Austria, Denmark, Netherlands)

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (AlphaEarth embeddings, Sentinel-2) for feature extraction; local MacBook/Colab CPU with GeoPandas/Shapely for LPIS-FTW polygon comparison and a shallow classifier (RF/XGBoost) for error typing
compute_path.why: All embedding/imagery pulled server-side via GEE catalog; polygon geometry comparison and a shallow tabular classifier run on CPU only, no sustained GPU training.
